title: Argentinian Beef Sandwiches
description: A classic Argentinian-inspired dish featuring grilled beef on toasted bread. Serve immediately and enjoy.
instructions: Season beef with salt and pepper on both sides.
Grill beef for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked to desired level of doneness.
Meanwhile, toast bread slices on grill or in toaster.
Assemble sandwiches by placing grilled beef on toasted bread, followed by a few slices of juicy beef.
